headline: Shrirampps Q2 net profit more than doubles YoY
summary: Shrirampps reported a consolidated net profit of 216 million rupees in Q2, up from 86 million rupees in the same period last year, while revenue fell to 1.84 billion rupees from 2 billion rupees.

headline: Globe Civil Projects Q2FY27: Revenue up 30% YoY
summary: Globe Civil Projects reported a 30.6% YoY rise in standalone revenue to ₹1,147.5 million for Q2FY27, though net profit declined 36% QoQ.

headline: Biocon gets US FDA nod for breast cancer biosimilar
summary: Biocon Limited received U.S. FDA approval for Pebrilzo, a biosimilar to Perjeta for HER2-positive breast cancer. This marks its fifth oncology biosimilar in the US, with commercial launch expected in Q3 2028.

headline: Glenmark launches generic Axitinib in US
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA launched authorized generic Axitinib tablets, targeting a market with $538.4 million annual sales.

headline: ABB India: Motilal Oswal upgrades to Buy
summary: Motilal Oswal upgrades ABB India to Buy with a target of ₹8,200, citing 56% YoY order inflow growth. HSBC maintains Reduce rating at ₹5,400 amid margin contraction.

headline: Goldman Sachs holds Neutral on Ashok Leyland, target ₹152
summary: Goldman Sachs maintains a Neutral rating on Ashok Leyland with a target price of ₹152. Q2 revenue and PAT were broadly in line with estimates, with revenue and EBITDA growing 39% and 16% YoY respectively.

headline: CLSA cuts Tata Motors target price to ₹369
summary: CLSA maintains Outperform on Tata Motors but cuts target price to ₹369. JLR Q2 EBIT margin fell 166 bps QoQ to 1.1%, with FY27 guidance cut to 2-3% EBIT margin.

headline: Kalpataru Projects secures new order worth ₹2,610 crore
summary: Kalpataru Projects International has secured a new order worth ₹2,610 crore, marking a significant contract win for the infrastructure company.
